verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud documents built-in Sales Flows (workflow automation). One community user reports building a timed email in Salesforce in minutes, which hints at time-based workflow execution. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents scheduling recurring jobs or flows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of scheduled or recurring flow and job triggers (cron-like intervals), CLI/API or agent-driven schedule management, and hands-on corroboration of recurring execution.
